extension.summary: ABC iView+ for Kodi with ABC Account support
extension.description: Browse and play ABC iview content in Kodi with ABC iView+. Includes ABC Account synchronisation and configurable Kodi TV library integration for manually selected, watched or watchlisted shows.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Australian Broadcasting Corporation. ABC and iview names and artwork remain the property of their respective owners.
extension.news:
2.4.1 - Makes the Library Integration enabled slide-over use ABC iView+ artwork instead of the generic information icon - Disables the sound for that successful enable notification while retaining audible error notifications - Retains all 2.4.0 synchronisation, hardening and one-second scheduler behaviour unchanged
2.4.0 - Renames the add-on display name to ABC iView+ so it is clearly distinguishable from the older Aussie Add-ons ABC iview add-on - Changes the lightweight scheduler heartbeat from 0.5 seconds to 1.0 second - Retains the same add-on ID, settings, generated library paths and media-source name so existing installations upgrade in place - Includes all 2.3.4 event-driven synchronisation, scan-loop prevention and hardening fixes unchanged
2.3.4 - Makes Kodi's built-in Update library command trigger one delayed ABC iView library reconciliation - Prevents external scans, add-on-owned scans and automatic cleanonupdate cleans from forming scan/clean feedback loops - Backs off unresolved episode-state writes instead of retrying once per second - Keeps the background service alive after transient library tick failures and retries after 30 seconds - Adds a 60-second durable-request safety check without restoring iView list polling - Tracks clean ownership explicitly and hardens scan/clean startup state against fast Kodi notifications
2.3.3 - Prevents recursive scan-clean-scan loops when Kodi cleanonupdate is enabled - Ignores scan-start notifications and add-on-owned scan-finished notifications as scheduling triggers - Preserves pending Kodi watched updates when unrelated library work runs - Retains all polling-free list-view and watched/resume fixes from 2.3.2
2.3.2 - Restores Kodi-library watched and unwatched writes to ABC using a dedicated three-second event queue - Prevents far-future library maintenance deadlines from delaying Kodi watched changes - Retries briefly when Kodi emits OnUpdate before the episode row is fully readable - Retains the polling-free iView list view and completed-without-resume display fixes from 2.3.1
2.3.1 - Removes constant library and action-queue polling while Kodi is idle or browsing iView - Uses event-driven, debounced Kodi/ABC library synchronisation with scheduled retries - Makes manual Apply settings and reconcile now wake the service immediately - Refreshes ABC history per folder render so recent watched changes display immediately - Shows completed episodes as watched with no resume point and prevents stale Kodi plugin rows overriding ABC state
2.3.0 - Promotes the proven 2.2.10 watched-state behaviour to the 2.3 release line - Uses unique same-directory temporary files for atomic generated library writes - Adds regression coverage for watched and library synchronisation paths
2.0.0 - Adds optional configurable Kodi TV library integration - Synchronises watched, unwatched and resume state between generated Kodi-library episodes and ABC accounts - Routes generated STRM playback through this add-on
